generic.title: Something went wrong
generic.body: We hit an unexpected error. Please try again in a moment.
generic.hint: If this keeps happening, refresh the page or contact support.

network.title: Connection problem
network.hint: Check your internet connection and try again.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.body: You don't have permission to do this.
forbidden.hint: Contact the project owner or an admin if you think this is a mistake.

notFound.title: Not found
notFound.body: We couldn't find what you were looking for.
notFound.hint: It may have been removed or the link is wrong.

rateLimit.title: Slow down a bit
rateLimit.hint: Please wait a few seconds and try again.

validation.title: Check your input
validation.hint: Fix the highlighted fields and submit again.

upload.title: Upload failed
upload.tooLarge: This file is too large. Maximum size is {{max}}.
upload.wrongType: This file type isn't supported. Allowed: {{types}}.
upload.hint: Try a smaller file or a different format.

server.title: Server error
server.body: Our servers had a problem handling that request.
server.hint: Please try again in a minute.
